Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly will your engineering team respond?
We guarantee an initial response within 24 hours. A senior technical lead or founder will review your inquiry and schedule a detailed technical discovery session.
Do we sign Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)?
Yes, absolutely. We prioritize your privacy and IP protection. We are happy to execute standard mutual NDAs prior to any code or architecture disclosures.
Can Coralgenz take over an existing codebase?
Yes. Our Legacy Modernization and Full-Stack teams specialize in architectural audits, performance refactoring, and zero-downtime infrastructure migrations.
